config.cuts: Front XY at C Z-bbox 25/50/75%; side ZY at C X-bbox 25/50/75%. Positions depend only on C.
config.figure_judgments: Renderer never fills review judgments. Optional source completion is local structural reference only, not a unique generation target.
config.local_bounds: C bbox plus fixed .075L X/Z and .10L Y margins; shared by all six cuts and local view.
config.normals: Source C face winding, at up to three spatially fixed face IDs; positive is not certified outward/interior.
config.orange: All F face IDs supplied by fixed original-query proximity diagnostic; not a prediction of redundant layers or illegality.
config.row_order: SMALL RAW, CREF RAW, SMALL POST, CREF POST
config.section_geometry: FP64 finite triangle-plane intersection; coplanar triangles contribute edges. No projected C outlines are drawn.
config.section_limit: Six predetermined slices can miss off-plane contacts/layers. Coplanar edges can overprint; count neither lines nor connected components as layers.
config.views_per_request: 4 states x (whole + three front cuts + close opposite view + three side cuts)
config.whole_bounds: Union of all registered cells and available optional reference of each C; identical physical scale across methods/noises/stages.
